bio: Are you a fan of fine Flemish fare and time-honoured bistro classics? If so, you can probably bet that your favourite dish will be on the menu here. Chef Gouwy bends over backwards to satisfy his guests and his disarmingly simple, wholesome menu is a treat for foodies: fresh fish served with risotto and beurre blanc – what could be better? The elegant, gilded bicycle that stands next to the kitchen, the chef’s own handiwork, will convince you of his deft craftsmanship....
